description: The hypothesis has a real, actionable test plan now -- move it from Formulated to Testing
Real evidence confirms this hypothesis -- mark it Validated
Real evidence contradicts this hypothesis -- mark it Invalidated
Real evidence exists but does not clearly confirm or contradict the hypothesis -- mark it Inconclusive
No real test has happened yet, or a named prerequisite blocks testing -- the hypothesis stays Formulated/Blocked
Whether this hypothesis's current evidence actually supports any of the above is ambiguous enough that a human should decide directly
